summary.text: Terri Bryant is a Republican member of the Illinois Senate for the 58th District, elected to the Senate in 2020 after being elected to the Illinois House in 2014.
She was chosen Assistant Republican Leader for the Senate Republican Caucus in 2023.

paragraphs.text: Bryant began her public service in 1994 at the Illinois Department of Corrections, where she rose to Public Service Administrator at the Pinckneyville Correctional Center and retired after 20 years of service in 2014.
Her biography also says she has experience in the farming and service industries, including owning the Bluebell Restaurant in Murphysboro.
Bryant was a Presidential Elector at the 2008 Illinois Republican Convention and served as Coordinator of Coalitions for the Illinois GOP.
She graduated from the Illinois Lincoln Excellence in Public Service Series in 2009 and was elected its president in 2011.
Her biography lists Bryant as Minority Spokesperson for the Energy and Public Utilities and the Behavioral and Mental Health committees.
Bryant lives in Murphysboro with her husband, Rick, and the couple have been married since 1981.
